start: A push to main that touches the watch app, forge-rest, the shortcut files or the watch UAT scripts

user_sees: Watch unit tests + rendered watch screens; artifacts 'watch-screens', 'shortcut-icons' (3 days on a push)
must_not: A screen a round watch would clip passing

steps.action: Build the watch release APK + AAB and the phone debug APK; check the watch APK
user_sees: Package com.mettleup.app, uses-feature android.hardware.type.watch, versionCode = 1_000_000_000 + the phone's, 'The release watch APK declares forgeai_watch_app.'

steps.action: Same signer and the signing dry run with a throwaway key
user_sees: 'Rotated watch APK: the new key on every watch API, with the debug key's lineage.'
must_not: The phone and watch APKs carrying different certificates

steps.action: Job 'uat' on API 34 large, API 35-ext15 large, API 34 small round
user_sees: 'Workout keeps MettleUp in front', 'Workout dims after interruptions', 'Workout dims with Always-on display OFF', and on the small watch 'The largest text on the small watch'
must_not: One leg's failure cancelling the others

start: A push that changes only scripts/ci/sign_rotated.sh (the release's watch signing)

user_sees: No 'Wear OS build' run (the path is not in the push list)
must_not: A signing change reaching a release tag without its dry run

start: A push that breaks a watch unit test

user_sees: 'Watch unit tests + watch screens (rendered)' red; 'wear-unit-tests' and 'watch-screens' still uploaded
must_not: The UAT job running on a broken build
The pictures lost because a test failed

steps.action: Push again while the first run is still going
user_sees: The first push run cancelled, the newer one runs
must_not: A hand-started run cancelled by a push

user_sees: The same build and uat jobs; artifacts kept 14 days
must_not: A later push cancelling this hand-started run

user_sees: The debug-signed-lineage watch APK, round-screen PNGs, UAT pictures and dumps
must_not: The debug-signed watch APK installed beside a Play phone app as if it would pair

start: UAT leg fails on one watch

steps.action: Open the failed leg 'watch UAT (api 35-ext15, wearos_large_round)'
user_sees: The other legs finished; pictures and dumps of the failed leg uploaded
must_not: No pictures of the failed leg

user_sees: Only the failed legs run again, against the same 'mettleup-wear' artifact
must_not: A green re-run that tested an old APK from another run
